name: Killer Couture
source:
You never thought it’d happen – a super cute guy asked you out. Naturally, you said yes. 

Now… what to wear? One fashion faux pas and it’s game over.

[From [url=https://lemonink.itch.io/killer-couture]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从未想过会发生这样的事——一个超级可爱的男人约你出去。自然，你说是。

现在……穿什么？一次时尚失礼，游戏就结束了。

[来自[url=https://lemonink.itch.io/killer-couture]Itch.io[/url]]
